blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `getCredentialsUpdatedAt` method. This belongs to the Auth Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).

This method retrieves when the credentials of a provider identity, such as its password, were last updated.
It uses the `getCredentialsUpdatedAt` method of the underlying provider, if the provider implements it.

The user's identifier. For example, when using the `emailpass`
provider, the `entity_id` would be the user's email.

types.name: Promise
types.description:
The date the credentials were last updated, or `null` if they were never updated
or the provider doesn't track it.
